body:
Search grows up: find Authors, Series and Volumes, even offline.

## Breaking changes

### Rename the setting ALLOWED_DIDS to SIGN_UP ([#90](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/90))

Sign-up now takes an Invite by default.

### Migration

Remove `ALLOWED_DIDS` from the settings of your instance. Set `SIGN_UP=invite` (the default) or `SIGN_UP=open`.

## New

### Search finds Authors, Series and Volumes, with Preferred Language and "I have it" ([#101](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/101))

Type a title, an author or a Series in **Check a book**: Search lists Authors, Series and Volumes, in your Preferred Language first.

### Search offline finds the books this device keeps ([#102](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/102))

With no signal, Search still finds the books you looked up on this device.

### Audience measurement with Rybbit, set by the instance ([#104](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/104))

An instance can count visits with Rybbit, with no cookie:

- off by default;
- named in the Privacy notice when on.

## Improvements

### Check a book has Scan and Search modes, with one Shelf Check answer ([#100](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/100))

## Fixes

### Make the offline status quiet, with the Reconnect icon alone ([#103](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/103))

The offline box no longer moves the sidebar.

## Maintenance

### Cut CI time from about 6 minutes to 2 ([#94](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/94))

### Docs for the app scripts ([#91](https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/pull/91))

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
name: Atomes v1.1.0

body:
The first versioned release of Atomes: everything built from M0 to M13.

## New

### Your Library

Keep every book you own: each Copy, the Edition you have, and who has it on Loan. Add a book with Quick Add (scan or type the ISBN), or start a whole Series at once with Series Onboarding. The Catalog finds the Work, the Edition and the cover from open book sources, and you can send a Series Correction when it is wrong.

### Reading

Set a Reading Status on each Work, sort your books with Labels and see what is Owned-Unread. Statistics show what you read, month by month, from your own dated records; share them as a picture.

### Series

Follow a Series to see its New Volumes, Upcoming Volumes and Missing Volumes. Drop a Series to stop following it. The To Buy list gathers the Volumes you miss.

### Shelf Check

In a bookshop, scan a barcode to see at once if you own the book, even offline.

### Accounts

Sign in with your email address and a Sign-in Code; an AT Protocol Account is optional. A new Account needs an Invite, and each reader can make one Invite for a friend. Choose what stays Private and what is Shared. In Settings, export all your data or delete your Account.

### For the Operator

An Admin panel for Invites, Accounts, Admins and the Admin Log. A Landing page at `/welcome`, a Privacy notice and a Legal notice. The app works in English and French, on a phone or a desktop, in light and dark.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/NeilujD/atomes/commits/v1.0.0
